data.name: Atmosfuture Limited
data.description: Atmosfuture Limited is a UK early-stage startup developing REVFRACC, a patented cryogenic direct air capture system that super-cools atmospheric air without fans to liquefy and separate CO2 while co-producing clean baseload power via a phase-change turbine. The company targets data centers and energy-intensive industries, was selected for Remove's Europe CDR accelerator in February 2025, and markets containerised pilot units of 30-100 MW. It remains a very small pre-commercial venture with only a handful of employees.
